required_before_expiry: Create a defensible backup or migration path for the canonical evidence store.
Verify restored hash-chain integrity on the target store before cutover.
Do not delete or mutate the current store until independent restore verification passes.
reopening_triggers: A secure export path from the canonical Postgres store becomes available.
A separately authorized replacement/upgrade datastore is selected.
A legitimate database credential handoff is configured through a secret manager without exposing the value.
